title.zh: 数据阶段：JDV比GDS更靠近写版
title.en: Data stage: JDV is closer to mask writing than GDS

subtitle.zh: 上游GDS更新，旧JDV可能立即失效
subtitle.en: Updating upstream GDS may immediately invalidate old JDV

body.zh: Tape-out 时间轴（数据阶段）
body.en: Tape-out timeline (data stages)

body.zh: DRC / LVS完成；电路与版图规则；一致性通过
body.en: DRC / LVS complete Circuit and layout rules pass consistency checks

body.zh: Stream Out；生成版图数据流；准备输出
body.en: Stream out Generate a layout data stream Prepare output

body.zh: GDS / OASIS交付；.gds；输出标准版图数据；交付下游
body.en: GDS / OASIS delivery .gds Output standard layout data Deliver downstream

body.zh: 数据接收检查；文件完整性与内容；一致性校验
body.en: Data receipt checks File completeness and content consistency verification

body.zh: 5；MDP与JDV生成；生成制造级数据；并封装校验信息
body.en: 5 MDP and JDV generation Generate manufacturing-level data and package validation information

body.zh: Mask Release；光罩制造与交付；进入生产使用
body.en: Mask release Mask manufacture and delivery Enter production use

body.zh: GDS当前版本；.gds；Top Cell；Layer Map；Checksum；生成时间
body.en: Current GDS version .gds Top cell Layer map Checksum Generation time

body.zh: MDP Job对应关系
body.en: MDP job mapping

body.zh: JDV对应版本；.jdv；Release Candidate；Mask Set；Checksum对应；生成时间
body.en: Corresponding JDV version .jdv Release candidate Mask set Matching checksum Generation time

body.zh: 若GDS发生更新，旧JDV不得继续签核
body.en: If GDS is updated, old JDV must not continue through sign-off

body.zh: 版本控制| Revision• 文件名•时间戳；vB；版本号与变更记录；文件命名规范；生成与更新时间戳；版本对齐与追溯
body.en: Version control | revision · filename · timestamp vB Version numbers and change records File naming conventions Generation and update timestamps Version alignment and traceability

body.zh: 输入控制 | Top Cell• Layer Map • Checksum；Top Cell匹配；Layer Map版本；数据完整性校验；校验码一致性
body.en: Input control | top cell · layer map · checksum Top-cell match Layer-map version Data-integrity verification Matching checksums

body.zh: 签核控制；Reviewer · Release ID · 状态；签核人角色；Release ID管理；签核状态流程；留痕与审计追踪
body.en: Sign-off control Reviewer · release ID · status Reviewer roles Release-ID management Sign-off status workflow Records and audit trail

body.zh: 常见；失效；打开旧JDV；数据已过期
body.en: Common failures Open old JDV Data is out of date

body.zh: GDS更新后；未重生成JDV
body.en: After updating GDS, JDV was not regenerated

body.zh: 多版本命名；混乱不清
body.en: Multiple version names are confusing

body.zh: 验证反馈：；File Hash / Version Matrix / Generation Time / Release Record
body.en: Verification feedback: File hash / version matrix / generation time / release record

body.zh: #；File Hash；文件哈希校验
body.en: # File hash File-hash verification

body.zh: Version Matrix；版本矩阵对齐
body.en: Version matrix Version-matrix alignment

body.zh: Generation Time；生成时间记录
body.en: Generation time Record generation time

body.zh: Release Record；签核记录归档
body.en: Release record Archive sign-off records
